svg.title: The Long Reach authoring readiness overlay
svg.desc: Two-panel authoring readiness overview and zoomed Milford Sound / Mosswell Fiordhead inset. The JSON macro atlas and seed locations remain authoritative for runtime transitions.

g.title: Northwatch Ranges: coverage partial; readiness snapshot partial; Northern approach highlands reached via Northgate Valley; transition metadata is wired, awaiting hand-authored mountain saddles and landmarks.
Eastfall Foothills: coverage none; readiness snapshot partial; Descending eastern foothill valleys beyond the alpine divide saddles; currently blocked at runtime (destinationReadiness: partial).

Fiordmarch West: coverage none; readiness snapshot blocked; Outer sea-cut Fiordland coast west/southwest of Mosswell; explicitly blocked by Fiord Deeps and Rainward Cliffwall until Westwall Shelf or watercraft routes are authored.
Southbreak Uplands: coverage none; readiness snapshot partial; Weather-cut southern uplands downstream of Southfork Vale; second-ring expansion queued behind Southfork Vale.

Rainward Escarpments: coverage none; readiness snapshot blocked; Sheer waterfall-cut granite escarpments (Darran/Franklin mountains) enclosing Mosswell Fiordhead and funneling travel into valley corridors.
Crownspine Divide: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Macro alpine spine modeled in the atlas for terrain coherence; no hand-authored high-alpine traversal zones yet.
Icefall Uplands: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Glacial basins and high tarn shelves (Aspiring/Aoraki inspiration); atlas concept only, unauthored.
Braidwater Basin & Run: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Wide inland braided-river basins (Mackenzie/Central Otago inspiration); unauthored distant interior.
Sunmere Plains: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Broad eastern low country inspired by the Canterbury Plains; unauthored future region.
Eastshelf Coast & Road: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Eastern coastal shelves and headland road; unauthored distant coastline.
Emberfen Lowlands: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Southeastern reed marshes, tidal creeks, and soft-ground breaks; unauthored distant lowlands.
Southtangle Coast: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Storm-beaten southern coves along Foveaux/Catlins inspiration coast; unauthored.
Unmapped Northern Reach: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Northern third of the inspiration map (Buller/Tasman/Marlborough); intentionally unmapped in the first-pass macro atlas.
Unmapped Southern Isle: coverage none; readiness snapshot unspecified; Offshore southern island (Stewart Island inspiration); no macro-atlas area assigned yet.
Mosswell Harbor Road: coverage complete; readiness snapshot ready; Seeded local harbor-to-gate spine linking Lower Jetty Landing, Mosswell River Jetty, North Road, and North Gate.

Northgate Valley: coverage partial; readiness snapshot partial; North/northeast valley route departing Mosswell North Gate along the Hollyford-like valley floor; atlas route continuity is ready while broader Northwatch highland content remains partial.

Southfork Vale: coverage none; readiness snapshot partial; Highest-priority overland expansion south from Mosswell South Farms down the Eglinton/Te Anau-like interior valley; currently blocked at runtime (destinationReadiness: partial).
Lantern Notch & Ashen Step: coverage none; readiness snapshot partial; High alpine saddles (Homer/Greenstone analogues) crossing from the Mosswell fiordhead canyon into Eastfall Foothills.
Westwall Shelf: coverage none; readiness snapshot blocked; Hazardous cliff-foot coastal track along the outer fiord walls; closed until Fiordmarch barrier mechanics and encounters are authored.
Fiord Deeps: coverage none; readiness snapshot blocked; Deep Milford Sound channel out to the Tasman Sea; blocks foot travel without watercraft.
Rainward Cliffwall: coverage none; readiness snapshot blocked; Near-vertical fiord sidewalls preventing direct cross-country climbs out of Mosswell.
Crownspine Knifeback: coverage none; readiness snapshot blocked; Main Southern Alps crestline dividing western rainforest/fiords from eastern interior basins; pass-limited crossing only.

Mosswell Village: coverage complete; readiness snapshot ready; 35 hand-authored Mosswell settlement locations anchored at Mosswell River Jetty on the Cleddau-like river mouth at the head of Milford Sound.

g.text: Mosswell sits at small-town scale on the river mouth at the head of Milford Sound
Counts — authored: 2 | transition-ready: 2 | next-to-author: 5 | blocked: 5 | inspiration-only: 9
• Approximate footprints — not surveyed GIS boundaries.
• transition-ready = partial readiness snapshot, not automatic runtime permission.
• Only Mosswell Fiordhead (35 local locations) is hand-authored; rest is frontier or inspiration.
• Atlas/runtime policy (theLongReachMacroAtlas.json) remains authoritative; coverage is independent.
Ordered outward from Mosswell; combine with runtime boundary signals via npm run report:long-reach
